versions.changelog:
- Clarified the list of supported write actions, specifying only six: create_task, update_task, set_task_dates, complete_task, uncomplete_task, and add_comment.
- Reworded "When to use/NOT use this skill" sections for precision and consistency.
- Updated skill description and usage guidance to reflect supported and unsupported write capabilities.
- No changes to functionality or CLI usage; documentation updates only.

Add 6 curated gap-filler tools — list_subtasks, list_task_comments, list_statuses, list_tags (reads); set_task_dates, uncomplete_task (writes, confirmation required). Brings the curated surface to 13 reads + 6 writes.
Add 4 light-write tools — create_task, update_task, complete_task, add_comment. Each requires explicit user confirmation before invoking.
Teach fan-out recovery for 469 errors on free plans

No changes detected in this release.

- Version number updated to 0.1.1.
- No modifications made to code or documentation.

Initial release – read-only access to Quire data via the quire CLI.

- Enables reading tasks, projects, and task trees from a user's Quire workspace
- Authentication fully managed by the CLI; no extra API keys or env vars needed
- Provides helpful usage guidance and detailed documentation for each supported command (whoami, mine, task list/get/search/tree, project list/get, resolve)
- Handles raw JSON output suitable for parsing and summarizing in chat
- Strictly read-only: all write actions are politely declined
- Designed to only trigger on Quire-related queries; does not handle other productivity tools
